title: Client forms are set up by urgency, and name their own request fields
description: Setting up a client form asks for less. The reference prefix is no longer a field, the turnaround is an urgency instead of a typed duration, and the title, description and target date fields can be renamed to suit the form.
items: The reference prefix is made from the form's name, as it already was when left blank
Urgency sets the turnaround: Urgent 3 working days, High 5, Normal 8, Low 12
Click a request field's label in the builder preview to rename it; clear it to go back to the default
Clients see the new labels on the public form
